description:
Create a control panel internal layout drawing in LibreCAD.

Specifications:
1. Unit: Millimeters.
2. Create these LAYERS with specific colors:
   - BACKPLATE (White/Black)
   - DINRAIL (Cyan)
   - WIREDUCT (Green)
   - COMPONENTS (Red)
   - LABELS (Yellow)
   - DIMENSIONS (Magenta)

3. Draw the PANEL BACKPLATE (on BACKPLATE layer):
   - Rectangle 600mm (W) x 800mm (H) starting at (0,0).

4. Draw 3 DIN RAILS (on DINRAIL layer):
   - Horizontal rails (35mm height) spanning X=80 to X=520.
   - Y positions: 650, 400, and 150.

5. Draw 4 WIRE DUCTS (on WIREDUCT layer):
   - 40mm wide raceways around the perimeter (inset 20mm from edge).

6. Draw COMPONENTS (on COMPONENTS layer) on the rails:
   - Top Rail: Main Breaker (60x70) at X=100; PLC (90x70) at X=200.
   - Middle Rail: 3 Contactors (55x55) at X=100, 200, 300.
   - Bottom Rail: Terminal Block Strip (300x40) at X=100.

7. Add TEXT LABELS (on LABELS layer):
   - Label components: QF1, PLC1, KM1, KM2, KM3, TB1.
   - Add title: 'MOTOR CONTROL PANEL - INTERNAL LAYOUT'.

8. Add DIMENSIONS (on DIMENSIONS layer):
   - Overall width (600) and height (800).
   - At least one vertical dimension for rail position.

Save the file to: /home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/control_panel_layout.dxf
